reviewer: Codex inspection of actual exported/reimported images and mechanical evidence
findings: Refined rifle prototype; actual front/rear/clay/side views inspected. Long rifle silhouette retains connected stock supports, a solid shaped grip, curved trigger within its open guard, seated sights and a correctly forward bored barrel.

Former box forearm is replaced with a tapered continuous handguard, actual barrel clearance and five cut ventilation slots per side. Complete ballistic magazine has 24.4 mm separation from the trigger guard; sampled exported reloads clear receiver, well, guard and handguard.
Exported visible bolt travel measures 27 mm; magazine withdrawal is approximately 250 mm. Four component animation clips retained. No hand IK or cartridge simulation claimed.

Viewed private car/character calibration comparison. Coated metal, exposed steel, patterned grip and bronze magazine share a 1024 albedo/ORM atlas with disjoint UV cells. Stencils are readable and correctly oriented on both sides. Meets modest refined-prototype stage; final weathering and runtime appearance remain later work.
Shared first-eight world loot; neutral field-service styling does not invent faction assignments.
